# Research: live-scores-api

*Auto-generated by AIDLC planning session*

**Question:** What free or low-cost APIs provide reliable real-time and final game scores for major US sports (NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL)? Which have WebSocket/SSE feeds vs polling? What are the rate limits, latency characteristics, and data freshness guarantees?

---

# Live Scores API Research: Major US Sports (NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL)

## Overview

Real-time sports score APIs vary widely in reliability, latency, and cost. This document covers the realistic options for developers building score-tracking applications, with concrete details on endpoints, pricing, and data delivery mechanisms.

---

## Option 1: ESPN Hidden/Undocumented API

**URL:** `https://site.api.espn.com/apis/site/v2/sports/`

**Cost:** Free (unofficial, no API key required)

**Status:** Undocumented but widely used by developers

### Endpoints

```
# NFL scores
GET https://site.api.espn.com/apis/site/v2/sports/football/nfl/scoreboard

# NBA scores
GET https://site.api.espn.com/apis/site/v2/sports/basketball/nba/scoreboard

# MLB scores
GET https://site.api.espn.com/apis/site/v2/sports/baseball/mlb/scoreboard

# NHL scores
GET https://site.api.espn.com/apis/site/v2/sports/hockey/nhl/scoreboard
```

### Query Parameters

```
?dates=20241015          # specific date (YYYYMMDD)
?limit=100               # number of events
?groups=50               # group filter (college sports)
```

### Sample Response Shape

```json
{
  "scoreboard": {
    "season": { "year": 2024, "type": 2 },
    "week": { "number": 6 },
    "events": [
      {
        "id": "401671806",
        "name": "Kansas City Chiefs at San Francisco 49ers",
        "shortName": "KC @ SF",
        "date": "2024-10-20T20:25Z",
        "status": {
          "clock": 420.0,
          "displayClock": "7:00",
          "period": 3,
          "type": {
            "id": "2",
            "name": "STATUS_IN_PROGRESS",
            "description": "In Progress",
            "detail": "7:00 - 3rd Quarter"
          }
        },
        "competitions": [{
          "competitors": [
            {
              "id": "12",
              "team": { "abbreviation": "KC", "displayName": "Kansas City Chiefs" },
              "score": "17",
              "homeAway": "away"
            },
            {
              "id": "25",
              "team": { "abbreviation": "SF", "displayName": "San Francisco 49ers" },
              "score": "14",
              "homeAway": "home"
            }
          ]
        }]
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

### Characteristics

- **Delivery:** Polling only (no WebSocket or SSE)
- **Refresh rate:** Data updates every ~30–60 seconds during live games
- **Rate limits:** Unofficial; anecdotally ~100–200 req/min before soft throttling; no published SLA
- **Latency:** Scores typically 30–90 seconds behind broadcast
- **Reliability:** High uptime (ESPN infrastructure), but breaking changes can happen without notice
- **Best for:** Side projects, personal dashboards, low-stakes applications

## Option 2: NBA Official Stats API

**URL:** `https://stats.nba.com/`

**Cost:** Free (unofficial, no key required)

### Key Endpoints

```
# Live scoreboard
GET https://cdn.nba.com/static/json/liveData/scoreboard/todaysScoreboard_00.json

# Live game box score (replace {gameId})
GET https://cdn.nba.com/static/json/liveData/boxscore/boxscore_{gameId}.json

# Play-by-play (replace {gameId})
GET https://cdn.nba.com/static/json/liveData/playbyplay/playbyplay_{gameId}.json
```

### Sample Scoreboard Response

```json
{
  "scoreboard": {
    "gameDate": "2024-10-22",
    "leagueName": "National Basketball Association",
    "leagueId": "00",
    "games": [
      {
        "gameId": "0022400001",
        "gameCode": "20241022/BOSLAL",
        "gameStatus": 2,
        "gameStatusText": "Q3 4:32",
        "period": 3,
        "gameClock": "PT04M32.00S",
        "homeTeam": {
          "teamId": 1610612747,
          "teamName": "Lakers",
          "teamCity": "Los Angeles",
          "teamTricode": "LAL",
          "wins": 0, "losses": 0,
          "score": 72
        },
        "awayTeam": {
          "teamId": 1610612738,
          "teamName": "Celtics",
          "teamCity": "Boston",
          "teamTricode": "BOS",
          "wins": 0, "losses": 0,
          "score": 68
        }
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

### Characteristics

- **Delivery:** Polling only
- **Refresh rate:** CDN-hosted JSON updated every ~10–15 seconds during games
- **Rate limits:** No published limits; requires `Referer: https://www.nba.com/` header and browser-like User-Agent to avoid blocks
- **Required headers:**
  ```
  Referer: https://www.nba.com/
  User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (compatible)
  Accept: application/json
  ```
- **Latency:** ~15–45 seconds behind live action
- **Best for:** NBA-specific apps needing play-by-play depth

## Option 3: NHL API (Official, Fully Supported)

**URL:** `https://api-web.nhle.com/`

**Cost:** Free, no API key required

**Status:** Official, documented, actively maintained

### Key Endpoints

```
# Today's schedule and live scores
GET https://api-web.nhle.com/v1/scoreboard/now

# Specific date
GET https://api-web.nhle.com/v1/score/2024-10-15

# Live game landing (detailed)
GET https://api-web.nhle.com/v1/gamecenter/{gameId}/landing

# Play-by-play
GET https://api-web.nhle.com/v1/gamecenter/{gameId}/play-by-play

# Box score
GET https://api-web.nhle.com/v1/gamecenter/{gameId}/boxscore
```

### Sample Score Response

```json
{
  "focusedDate": "2024-10-15",
  "games": [
    {
      "id": 2024020001,
      "season": 20242025,
      "gameType": 2,
```

### Characteristics

- **Delivery:** Polling only (no official WebSocket)
- **Refresh rate:** ~10 seconds during live games
- **Rate limits:** Generous; no documented caps; practical limit ~120 req/min
- **Latency:** 10–30 seconds
- **Coverage:** Full NHL only
- **Best for:** Any NHL application — this is the most developer-friendly official API of the four leagues

## Option 4: MLB Stats API (Official)

**URL:** `https://statsapi.mlb.com/`

**Cost:** Free, no API key required

**Status:** Official, well-documented

### Key Endpoints

```
# Today's schedule with live scores
GET https://statsapi.mlb.com/api/v1/schedule?sportId=1&hydrate=linescore

# Specific date
GET https://statsapi.mlb.com/api/v1/schedule?sportId=1&date=2024-10-01

# Live game feed (most detailed)
GET https://statsapi.mlb.com/api/v1.1/game/{gamePk}/feed/live

# Live game feed diff (changes since timecode)
GET https://statsapi.mlb.com/api/v1.1/game/{gamePk}/feed/live/diffPatch?startTimecode=20241001_235959
```

### Sample Linescore in Schedule

```json
{
  "dates": [{
    "date": "2024-10-01",
    "games": [{
      "gamePk": 745455,
      "gameType": "R",
      "status": {
        "abstractGameState": "Live",
        "detailedState": "In Progress"
      },
      "teams": {
        "away": {
          "score": 3,
          "team": { "id": 147, "name": "New York Yankees" }
        },
        "home": {
          "score": 1,
          "team": { "id": 111, "name": "Boston Red Sox" }
        }
      },
      "linescore": {
        "currentInning": 7,
        "currentInningOrdinal": "7th",
        "inningHalf": "Top",
        "outs": 1,
        "balls": 2,
        "strikes": 1,
        "innings": [
          { "num": 1, "home": {"runs": 0}, "away": {"runs": 2} }
        ]
      }
    }]
  }]
}
```

### The `diffPatch` Endpoint

This is unique among free APIs — it returns only changes since a given timecode, reducing payload size:

```bash
# Get initial state
curl "https://statsapi.mlb.com/api/v1.1/game/745455/feed/live"
# Note the metaData.timeStamp from response: e.g. "20241001_235901"

# Poll for changes only
curl "https://statsapi.mlb.com/api/v1.1/game/745455/feed/live/diffPatch?startTimecode=20241001_235901"
```

### Characteristics

- **Delivery:** Polling + diff endpoint (pseudo-efficient polling)
- **Refresh rate:** Full feed updates every ~5–10 seconds; diff endpoint usable at ~5s intervals
- **Rate limits:** No documented caps; aggressive polling (sub-5s) may trigger soft blocks
- **Latency:** 5–20 seconds — one of the lowest-latency free options
- **Best for:** Baseball apps needing granular pitch-by-pitch or play-by-play data

## Option 5: The-Odds-API (Scores Endpoint)

**URL:** `https://api.the-odds-api.com/`

**Cost:** Free tier: 500 requests/month; $0 for score data specifically on paid plans from ~$79/month

**Status:** Commercial, well-documented, actively supported

### Score Endpoint

```
GET https://api.the-odds-api.com/v4/sports/{sport}/scores/
  ?apiKey=YOUR_KEY
  &daysFrom=1          # 1-3 days of completed games
  &dateFormat=iso
```

**Sport keys:**
- `americanfootball_nfl`
- `basketball_nba`
- `baseball_mlb`
- `icehockey_nhl`

### Sample Response

```json
[
  {
    "id": "abc123",
    "sport_key": "basketball_nba",
    "sport_title": "NBA",
    "commence_time": "2024-10-22T00:00:00Z",
    "completed": false,
    "home_team": "Los Angeles Lakers",
    "away_team": "Boston Celtics",
    "scores": [
      { "name": "Los Angeles Lakers", "score": "72" },
      { "name": "Boston Celtics", "score": "68" }
    ],
    "last_update": "2024-10-22T01:42:30Z"
  }
]
```

### Characteristics

- **Delivery:** Polling only
- **Refresh rate:** 30–60 seconds during live games
- **Rate limits:** Free tier: 500 req/month total across all endpoints; paid ~$79/month for unlimited
- **Latency:** 30–90 seconds
- **Best for:** Apps that already use odds data and want scores as a secondary feature

## Option 6: API-Sports (api-sports.io)

**URL:** `https://api-sports.io/`

**Cost:** Free tier: 100 requests/day; Pro from ~$14.99/month (500 req/day), higher tiers available

**Status:** Commercial, documented, covers all four major sports

### Endpoints

```
# NFL live scores
GET https://v1.american-football.api-sports.io/games?live=all
Authorization: x-apisports-key: YOUR_KEY

# NBA live scores
GET https://v1.basketball.api-sports.io/games?live=all

# MLB live scores
GET https://v1.baseball.api-sports.io/games?live=all

# NHL live scores
GET https://v1.hockey.api-sports.io/games?live=all
```

### Sample Live Game Response

```json
{
  "response": [
    {
      "id": 12345,
      "date": "2024-10-22T19:30:00+00:00",
      "status": {
        "short": "Q3",

      },
      "teams": {
```

### Characteristics

- **Delivery:** Polling only
- **Rate limits:** 100 req/day free; 500 req/day ~$15/month; 7,500 req/day ~$30/month
- **Latency:** 30–60 seconds
- **Coverage:** All four sports under one API key/interface
- **Best for:** Apps covering multiple sports that want a unified API surface

## Option 7: SportsDataIO

**URL:** `https://sportsdata.io/`

**Cost:** Free tier available (limited historical + live endpoints); paid from ~$9/month per sport

**Status:** Commercial, well-established

### Characteristics

- **Delivery:** REST polling + some WebSocket feeds on higher tiers
- **Rate limits:** Free tier is very limited (historical data focus); paid tiers ~1,000 req/day
- **Latency:** 5–15 seconds on paid plans
- **WebSocket:** Available on Professional+ plans for real-time push
- **Best for:** Production apps with budget that need low-latency push delivery

---

## Option 8: Sportradar

**URL:** `https://sportradar.com/`

**Cost:** Free trial (30-day); paid from ~$150–500+/month per sport

**Status:** Enterprise-grade, official partner of NFL/NBA/MLB/NHL

### Characteristics

- **Delivery:** Push feeds (WebSocket/MQTT) + REST polling
- **Latency:** 1–5 seconds; push feeds can be sub-second for in-play events
- **Rate limits:** Generous on paid plans; SLA-backed
- **Coverage:** Deepest stats available — official data partner for NFL, NBA, NHL
- **Best for:** Commercial applications, sportsbooks, broadcast overlays

## Delivery Mechanism Comparison

| API | WebSocket/SSE | Best Poll Interval | Latency |
|-----|--------------|-------------------|---------|
| ESPN (unofficial) | No | 30s | 30–90s |
| NBA Stats (unofficial) | No | 15s | 15–45s |
| NHL API (official) | No | 10s | 10–30s |
| MLB Stats API (official) | No (diff endpoint) | 5–10s | 5–20s |
| The-Odds-API | No | 30s | 30–90s |
| API-Sports | No | 30s | 30–60s |
| SportsDataIO (paid) | Yes (higher tiers) | 5–10s | 5–15s |
| Sportradar (paid) | Yes (push) | N/A | 1–5s |

## Practical Polling Strategy

For free-tier applications, efficient polling matters to stay within rate limits:

```typescript
// Adaptive polling: faster during live games, slower otherwise
async function adaptivePoll(gameId: string) {
  const LIVE_INTERVAL = 15_000;    // 15s during game
  const IDLE_INTERVAL = 60_000;    // 60s between games

  let intervalMs = IDLE_INTERVAL;

  while (true) {
    const game = await fetchGameState(gameId);

    if (game.status === 'live') {
      intervalMs = LIVE_INTERVAL;
      broadcastUpdate(game);
    } else if (game.status === 'final') {
      broadcastUpdate(game);
      break; // stop polling
    } else {
      intervalMs = IDLE_INTERVAL;
    }

    await sleep(intervalMs);
  }
}
```

## Free-Tier Summary & Recommendations

| Use Case | Recommended API | Why |
|----------|----------------|-----|
| NFL only | ESPN unofficial | Only widely-used free NFL live score source |
| NBA only | NBA Stats CDN | Official, fast, deep play-by-play |
| MLB only | MLB Stats API | Best free latency (~5s), official, diffPatch |
| NHL only | NHL API | Official, documented, developer-friendly |
| All 4 sports, free | ESPN unofficial | Single endpoint covers all; acceptable latency |
| All 4 sports, paid | API-Sports (~$15–30/mo) | Unified interface, reasonable cost |
| Production / commercial | Sportradar | Push feeds, SLA, official data partner |

---

## Known Gotchas

1. **ESPN unofficial API** — No versioning guarantee. Breaking changes have occurred ~2–3 times since 2020. Worth adding response shape validation.

2. **NBA Stats headers** — Requests without a valid `Referer: https://www.nba.com/` header will return 403. This is enforced server-side.

3. **NHL API migration** — The old `statsapi.web.nhl.com` domain was deprecated in 2023. All new development should use `api-web.nhle.com`.

4. **MLB diffPatch timecodes** — The timecode format is `YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS` in UTC. Off-by-one errors in timecode construction cause full-feed responses instead of diffs, burning bandwidth.

5. **CORS** — Most of these APIs do not send CORS headers, meaning browser-direct requests will fail. Always proxy through your own backend.

6. **Rate limit headers** — API-Sports and The-Odds-API return remaining quota in response headers (`x-requests-remaining`, `x-requests-used`). Consume these to avoid surprise overages.
